What we do

OUR ROOFING SERVICES

Whether your roof needs a quick repair, a full restoration or a brand-new installation, we're here to help.

New Roofs & Extensions

Roof installations for new builds and extensions, including tile, ceramic and slate roofing.

Roof Repairs & Leaks

Repairs to damaged roofing, leaking areas and storm-affected roofs.

Roof Restorations

Refresh and restore tired roofs to improve their appearance and condition.

Rebedding & Repointing

Ridge cap rebedding and repointing to maintain your tiled roof.

Roof Pressure Washing & Moss Removal

Roof pressure washing and removal of moss, lichen, dirt and grime, using methods appropriate for the roof material.

Roof Painting

Roof painting and coating services to refresh the appearance of suitable roofing surfaces.

Valley Irons & Metal Work

Valley iron replacement and basic metal roofing work.

Slate & Shingle Roofing

Slate and shingle roof installation, maintenance and repairs.

Flashing & Lead Flashing

Roof flashing and lead flashing installation, repairs and replacement.

About ASAP Roofing

YOUR LOCAL ROOF SPECIALIST

ASAP Roofing is led by Josiah Sutton, bringing 10+ years of roofing experience to every job. We primarily serve Melbourne’s western suburbs and also take on jobs across greater Melbourne and Geelong. We take pride in reliable service, quality workmanship and helping homeowners protect what matters most.
